title: Crashes when switching panels in the GUI
body:
### Tested versions

v4.5.dev3.official [28089c4], v4.5.dev4.official [209a446]

### Issue description

I'm encountering an error, but I haven’t been able to fully track it down. The first time I saw it was after switching to version 4.5 dev3 - everything was fine on dev2 and earlier. The issue started when I switched between tilemap editors. Based on its behavior, it seems like the editor is transitioning but doesn’t manage to clean something up in time, the loading gets stuck at 50%, and then everything breaks.

I’ve been hunting this bug for a week now, and the only consistent pattern I’ve found is this:
`ERROR: 1 RID allocations of type 'N10RendererRD14TextureStorage7TextureE' were leaked at exit.`
Today I had this crash happen twice when switching between scenes in the editor.

### Steps to reproduce

I’m working with a rather large tilemap - around 60,000 blocks - and I have several maps like that. I don’t believe this is caused by my code, since I don’t have any logic that would explain it. I honestly have no idea how to properly diagnose this, but the crashes are starting to get annoying. From what I can tell, the engine simply doesn’t have time to clean something up, and this doesn't appear to be caused by my logic. For now, I suspect it's related to the size of the tilemap - possibly due to large texture sizes.
